name: manual_a4a3cf
claim: Check a fixed-wall owner name by normalizing first, then matching: NFKC fold, drop format characters, NFKD, drop combining marks, casefold, strip non-alphanumerics, then test each wall name as a substring of each owner separately, and refuse any name that is non-ASCII or empty after folding. Comparing whole word tokens is bypassable by accents, glued names, fullwidth or zero-width characters and Cyrillic look-alikes. Over-refusal (a name containing agate) is deliberate and should be tested, not hidden.
conditions: owner check normalization unicode lookalike fixed-wall mechanism card

decisions.notes: 2026-11-17: an independent probe passed oramasys/phylax and phylax.admission through a token check; the automated security review then showed Phylax with an accent and phylaxpolicy also passed; the substring-after-normalization version refused all of them and the new tests pass.
